cadence.name: pentad
cadence.note: every `h` in this file is an AXIS STEP, not a month. The horizon-band keys carry their own day spans for the same reason. `horizon_auc` averages msss_clim over h=1..horizon_steps and is therefore a function of THIS axis's lead sampling; `horizon_auc_daymatched` averages the twelve leads above, which are the monthly archive's, and is the ONLY one of the two that may be compared against an archived corridor AUC.

starts.rule: every k-th start of the holdout year's list, k = len(list)//N, first N — deterministic, keeps the start whose h=1 is the year's first row, and spreads the rest evenly round the seasonal cycle

inputs.doc: E-051-roll-B (the RECALL TEST on the old head) · Re-rolls head-weights-e051-398k-xl144zn-pentad-s0 (the 398k K=144 pentad head #503 rolled to day-matched corridor AUC 0.944 with a FLAT skill-vs-lead profile) with the replay battery SHORTENED to 36 months each way (longm:36,futm:36 -> 219+219 axis steps) so the whole job — 441 skill + 438 battery = 879 steps at the measured 87.1 s/step = ~21.3 h — finishes INSIDE its 24 h token, where #503's 20-year battery (2,922 steps, ~71 h past its own 40 h timeout) could never write its result. params 206.66M head over the frozen 37.976M run-415 codec (both frozen; NOTHING trains) · stage sroll · data family4_na025_pentad_r2 · arch head 1024x16 K 144 stencil 145 ring spiral; codec 512x12 d_z 32 patch 1 · steps 197428 (= run-415's count, zero training) · resume run-415. THE QUESTION: is 0.944 recall? The mechanism is now known (the endpoint-scope pool teacher-forced holdout-year transitions; see E-059 and commit c25f6ff) — this run measures its signature on the artefact itself. Falsifier, pre-registered: the FUTURE roll runs past the record's end, where no measured bins existed to memorize — if the head's behaviour there (dispersion, drift to climatology) breaks sharply from its in-record tracking, 0.944 is recall; a long-roll tracking-r-vs-lead profile that stays flat through TRAINED years while the skill phase was equally flat in holdout years is the same verdict from the other side. The 441 skill steps double as the protocol-determinism certificate (must reproduce #503's scored partial bit-for-bit, §3b). (Re-dispatch of cancelled #503 with the battery sized to finish; skill numbers already in hand from its partial.) RE-DISPATCH of #508, which died in 90 s with a Bus error: the disk was full of #503's cancelled-run leftovers (its 31.6 GiB anomaly-transform scratch copy + dumproll trajectories), neither of which disk_hygiene knew — both are now tier 0 (commit e661b3f), so this run's own start-of-job hygiene frees them. SECOND re-dispatch: #509 then died in `Set up job` — at 100% the disk kills the job BEFORE any step can run hygiene, the exact trap the script's own comments describe — so the box (Vast 48937792) was destroyed (everything on it published or harvested) and this runs on a fresh 100 GB box (gpu-box-35586926, 129 GB RAM), cold-seeding tensor/Z/codec/head from the releases.
